answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to bond capital to propose blocks. The delta of expected returns discourages malicious behavior, as an attacker must acquire significant supply to control consensus. Like a delicate opal, the system integrity is fragile if security is low, necessitating a quill to record immutable stake distribution. An attacker incurs the full cost of asset acquisition, facing massive financial ruin if they attempt to subvert the protocol.
